marketing_description: The Milwaukee M12™ Right Angle Die Grinder (part 3485-20) delivers 0‑20,000 RPM with a 4‑speed variable trigger, powered by a 12 V M12™ REDLITHIUM™ 2 Ah battery and a POWERSTATE™ brushless motor. Its 2‑1/2 in wheel and 1/4 in collet are housed in an alloy steel and glass‑filled nylon case with a black/red finish, while the barrel‑grip rubber handle provides ergonomic control for tight‑space work.
